target_customer: Ecommerce brands, mostly on Shopify and BigCommerce, that want to build and optimize storefront pages without developers
problem: Merchants needed custom, fast storefront pages and experiments beyond theme limits. Shogun provides a no code page builder, then headless Frontend, A/B testing and personalization.
business_model: SaaS subscription tiers, for example 39, 249 and 499 dollars monthly per 2026 comparison pages
product_category: Ecommerce page builder and storefront platform

founders.name: Finbarr Taylor
founders.background_notes: Software engineer and Visiting Partner at YC; former CEO and CTO.

founders.name: Nick Raushenbush
founders.background_notes: Former CEO and COO of Shogun; YC angel investor.

technical_complexity.rationale: A visual page builder integrated with Shopify themes and later a headless storefront stack is standard but sizable front end engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Pages built in the tool lock merchants in, but many Shopify page builders exist and compete on price.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Shopify added its own theme editing, but Shogun stayed independent and grew to over 20 thousand customers per its YC page; a layoff of dozens was reported in August 2022.

market_need_then: Direct to consumer brands on Shopify were growing and wanted faster, conversion focused pages; 2020 and 2021 ecommerce growth supported later rounds.

branding.domain_note: Uses getshogun.com, an exact .com with get prefix, per the site URL; purchase history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short paired headlines such as Launch faster and Stay in control

branding.community_and_virality: Widely covered in Shopify app comparison and review pages; Shopify merchant brand names such as MVMT and Chubbies as customers

brand_strength.rationale: Well known among Shopify merchants with many comparison pages, though no source shows brand led growth.

pivots.why: Announced with the Series A to speed up ecommerce sites

outcome_analysis: Shogun raised 2.1 million in 2018, 10 million in a Series A in February 2020, 35 million from Accel in October 2020 and 67.5 million from Insight in June 2021, reaching about 114.5 million total. It grew with ecommerce and added Frontend, AI and Insights products. A layoff of dozens was reported in August 2022, and it remains independent with a team of about 90 per YC.
